question: Does the earlier tie in complete mixed-group yield persist on fresh tasks at equal cumulative token eligibility cutoffs?
numeric_filters: Unchanged: at least 10000 witnessed feasible plans; movement-only optimum is at least 60 points worse under full handoff cost. Maximum 30 numerical proposals. No tested-model response is used to select a task.
collector_rule: Uniform completes four; adaptive abandons a unanimous known two-outcome prefix, otherwise continues to four.
token_unit: input_tokens + output_tokens; cached input is already within input; reasoning output is already within output. CLI context overhead is included.
boundary: Usage arrives only after a complete CLI call. Charge and retain the first crossing call, do not execute its action, and set its interrupted trajectory reward to null. Credit only complete groups ending within the exact common cutoff. Report actual spend and crossing-call overrun separately. No artificial token padding.
primary: Complete mixed groups of four at 6M eligible tokens in each disjoint block, summed across four blocks per model and collector.
secondary: Paired block differences and all 16 sign-flip permutations, descriptive with only four blocks
Within-block cumulative mixed-group curves at predeclared 1M-token checkpoints
Task coverage, completed rewards, unknown cutoffs, exact cost gaps, tokens, time and actual overrun
Prefix-matched sensitivity at the smaller actual eligible spend of each paired block, labeled post hoc
